quantizer: Per-token per-KV-head contiguous-channel groups32; scale=max(max(abs(x)),1e-12)/7; round ties-even, clamp[-7,7], materialize int16 integer codes, FP32 multiply, BF16 decoded rounding. Quantize only selected K/V on initialization and every append. Unselected role remains byte-exact BF16.
candidate_acceptance: Both sources/all steps pass both references AND baseline does not diverge. If baseline exceeds .025, retain per-reference gates but any combined pass is BASELINE_DIVERGENCE_UNRESOLVED, not fidelity preservation.
stop: Mixed-cache init/append/prefix/role oracle parity or replay/reference failure, nonfinite metrics, resource gate, or own-worker timeout. Preserve every failure; justified repair max2 with new frozen source/run identity.
scope: Exploratory two-source local logit fidelity screen, no CI/population test. Dense independent mixed representation reference persists dequantized BF16 values; no physical cache saving/capacity or optimized kernel claim. INT8 and lowering repair are deferred pending advisor review.
